meta.tldr: 150 PRs opened across the three free creative apps: michaelmonetized/omadesign (109) for keyboard access, editable file exchange and Live collaboration; michaelmonetized/omatainer (23) for plugin hosting and surround delivery; michaelmonetized/editbay (18) for HDR and high-depth masters

shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omadesign · 109 PRs opened
shipped.summary: A day-long run of open PRs for the next Omadesign releases, centered on full keyboard access, editable round-trips with other design formats, and higher-precision pixels. All are open for review; none merged in this window.
bullets: Keyboard reach and stable field names across Design, Photo and Motion panels and dialogs
Editable import and export for SVG, PDF, IDML, PSD, Affinity and Illustrator files
RAW and high-depth pixels kept in floating point with memory-aware loading
Live collaboration with presence, offline reconnect and per-author undo
Editable 3D scenes, motion expressions, and 0.6.4–0.6.7 release prep

shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omatainer · 23 PRs opened
shipped.summary: Open PRs for the music production app covering native plugin hosting, surround speaker layouts, and delivery-grade audio files. All are open for review.
bullets: CLAP and LV2 plugins hosted in isolated workers with saved state
Declared 2.1, 5.1 and 7.1 speaker routing with matching masters and stems
RF64 BWF and AIFF streaming plus loudness-checked final audio
Keyboard authoring for tracks, delivery and plugin rows

shipped.title: michaelmonetized/editbay · 18 PRs opened
shipped.summary: Open PRs for the film editor focused on HDR color, high-depth delivery formats, and editorial tools. All are open for review.
bullets: HDR processing with a saved luminance scale and retained mastering tags
Lossless16, DNxHR HQX, HEVC Main8 and high-depth VP9 masters
Editable captions, multicam cutting, color scopes and exact relinking
Keyboard timeline authoring and saved task workspaces
